topic_thesis: Your favorite brands aren't suffering from inflation; they are using it as a smokescreen to hike prices by 13% while your purchasing power evaporates.
strategic_angle: Expose the 'Cost-Push Pass-Through' lie: Corporations report record margins while claiming supply chain struggles force them to hike prices, effectively taxing the middle class to protect shareholder dividends.
target_emotion: Outrage at corporate greed and financial betrayal
pinned_comment_text: Are you feeling the pinch in your monthly grocery bill? Which brand do you think is hiking prices the most? Comment 'GUIDE' if you want our tracker on how to spot these hidden price hikes before you checkout! 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Use a tone of 'Corporate Loot' (Corporate kolla). Use terms like 'Price hike-ah koodi unga pocket-ah kaali panraanga', 'Middle class-ku dhaan kastaam', and 'Namma kitta irundhu edukkuraanga'. Emphasize that the 'Supply chain excuse' is just a 'veenaana reason'.
source_signal: Consumer pain-point regarding rising cost of living and stagnant wage growth
